caption: The drawing depicts a pair of knitted mitts or fingerless gloves, laid out flat side by side with the thumb sections pointing toward the right. Both mitts are primarily beige or light cream in color, with a subtle vertical pattern suggesting texture. The mitt on the left features decorative embroidery, including a large pink flower with green leaves at the top near the thumb, as well as smaller floral designs in shades of pink, blue, and peach distributed along the length of the mitt. The flowers are accompanied by green leafy stems. The mitt on the right shows the reverse side, with only a few small floral and leafy patterns visible in corresponding locations, including blue and pink flowers with green leaves. The background of the drawing is plain and light, allowing the mitts and their embroidered decorations to stand out. The artist's signature, "Ruth M. Barnes," appears in the bottom right corner, with a small inscription and numbers in the bottom left corner.
title: Mitts
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
